Party.description: A person the pharmacy deals with: a patient, a doctor, a carer or a pharmacist. A first name alone is not an identity.

Medicine.description: A medicine the pharmacy stocks or dispenses, by brand.

CareLink.description:
Who acts for a patient in which way: the doctor who prescribes, the carer who looks after them, or the pharmacist who dispenses.
Caring for someone is not prescribing for them.

Interaction.description: How one medicine affects another taken alongside it: it clashes with it, or boosts its effect.

Prescription.description: A medicine dispensed for a patient. patient takes it, prescriber wrote it, collected_by picked it up from the counter.

Shortage.description: A medicine running short in stock: how many packs are left and whether it is low or out.

questions.q: Who is the prescriber of Farida Haddad?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party)-[:prescriber]->(n1:Party) WHERE n0.name = 'Farida Haddad' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: esperanza
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party)-[:carer]->(n1:Party) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: tomasz
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party)-[:customer]->(n1:Party) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Medicine)-[:clashes]->(n1:Medicine) WHERE n0.brand = 'Ostrafen' RETURN n1.brand AS brand

questions.q: What is the booster of Tessaline?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Medicine)-[:booster]->(n1:Medicine) WHERE n0.brand = 'Tessaline' RETURN n1.brand AS brand

questions.q: Is there a record of a repeat on the prescriptions of Mireille Dubois?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party)<-[:patient]-(n1:Prescription) WHERE n0.name = 'Mireille Dubois' RETURN coalesce(n1.repeat, false) AS repeat

questions.q: Is the Halvenor prescription a repeat?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Medicine)<-[:medicine]-(n1:Prescription) WHERE n0.brand = 'Halvenor' RETURN n1.repeat AS repeat

questions.q: What quantity was on the prescriptions I collected?
questions.speaker: olu_a
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party)<-[:collected_by]-(n1:Prescription) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.quantity AS quantity

questions.q: Who prescribed the prescriptions that Ngaio Parata collected?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party)<-[:collected_by]-(n1:Prescription)-[:prescriber]->(n2:Party) WHERE n0.name = 'Ngaio Parata' RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: How many packs of Ciruvel are left in the shortage?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Medicine)<-[:medicine]-(n1:Shortage) WHERE n0.brand = 'Ciruvel' RETURN n1.packs_left AS packs_left

questions.q: What is the status of the prescription taken with food?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Prescription) WHERE n0.directions CONTAINS 'food' RETURN n0.status AS status

questions.q: What is the registration number of Kenji Arakawa?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Party) WHERE n0.name = 'Kenji Arakawa' RETURN n0.registration_number AS registration_number

questions.q: For each shortage, how many packs are left and how severe is it?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Shortage) RETURN n0.packs_left AS packs_left, n0.severity AS severity

questions.q: Who is the pharmacist for Esperanza Villalobos?
